inspection: Read all 46 panel prefab files plus runtime view/controller scripts. Static structural audit; not a runtime visibility assertion.
global_constraints: Original node hierarchy, controls and relative layout are authoritative.
Warm pale honey wood, cream and green; sharply reduce leaf/flower decoration.
No text may cross its content area or the outer panel.
No dynamic/localized amounts or text should be painted into shipping assets.
Use runtime screenshots for actual text, localized values and visibility. Serialized New Text values are not final copy.
Main page is composed from MainPanel + LocalGameplay + LocalMainPanelTop + MainPanelBottom + LocalSubrounds; MainPanelComplete is not the current default entry.
AI previews must be labeled separately from actual Unity screenshots and original-game captures.

page_families.title: Main gameplay
page_families.constraints: Preserve cash + diamonds top cards, five milestone row, gameplay board and all five toolbar controls; variable guide/progress visibility must match screenshot.

page_families.title: Startup loading
page_families.constraints: Logo/loading text/progress, no invented button.

page_families.title: Level failed
page_families.constraints: Keep Restart and Revive as distinct actions; retain item count, ad indicator and dynamic failure tip.

page_families.title: Tool offer: Undo / Refresh / Add Screw
page_families.constraints: One shared layout with three icon/title/description variants; two controls: close and ad claim. No extra inner card around description.

page_families.title: General message
page_families.constraints: Title, variable-length content, one OK button.

page_families.title: New-player guide overlay
page_families.constraints: Context-dependent guide mask/cutout, pointing cue, text and close/click-through controls; cannot replace with unrelated full modal.

page_families.title: Replay confirmation
page_families.constraints: Two actual Button components; CloseBtn and ReplayBtn intentionally reference the same control. Do not invent a third close button.

page_families.title: Reward collection overlay
page_families.constraints: Zero fixed buttons; reward items are instantiated from configured prefabs and auto-collected. Not an empty panel design.

page_families.title: Level success
page_families.constraints: Three controls: multiplier claim, close, small-claim text. Dynamic reward items remain semantic cash/diamonds/tools.

page_families.title: Alternate channel contact
page_families.constraints: Close plus submit; one dynamic contact input, localized instruction.

page_families.title: My Diamonds
page_families.constraints: Six controls: close, four amounts in 2x2 grid, Withdraw. Diamond balance, converted cash, rate ribbon, selected-tier description and progress stay in existing order. No nested thick selection tray.

page_families.title: Withdrawal loading
page_families.constraints: Loading status only, zero buttons. Preserve animation/status meaning.

page_families.title: Withdrawal target reached
page_families.constraints: Single withdrawal action, cash amount/icon and title, preserve reward meaning.

page_families.title: Withdrawal level/status
page_families.constraints: Two controls: claim/confirm and close. Cash amount, status and progress-step labels stay in their defined blocks.

page_families.title: Level withdrawal
page_families.constraints: Two controls: close and Withdraw. Cash amount above progress and requirement; stats three columns below main card; record strip below stats. Preserve expanded labels and avoid extra inner panels.

page_families.title: Withdrawal processing steps
page_families.constraints: Close and Continue; timestamped vertical stages and dynamic verification/status block retain order.

page_families.title: Withdrawal introduction
page_families.constraints: Single Start control; five ordered milestone markers and original explanatory copy.

page_families.title: Withdrawal speed verification
page_families.constraints: Single IKnow button, level/video requirements and progress blocks; do not merge requirement progress values.

page_families.title: Enter Information
page_families.constraints: Six controls: three payment channels, Confirm, Close, Help. Four serialized InputFields with name/email/phone/country-code visibility variants. Keep actual branding; no form-group backdrop crossing outer border.

page_families.title: Confirm account
page_families.constraints: Three controls: close, confirm payout, re-enter. Selected payment brand and dynamic entered account details.

page_families.title: Gameplay unlock
page_families.constraints: Single Continue control, mechanic illustration, title and explanation.
